description: Captures HubSpot CMS sites whose content is a HubSpot Video player rather than text: finds the lazy-loaded player, downloads its video and queues it for transcription.
name: channel-hubspot-video

watch.note: Keep `transcribe.when: always`. On this platform a page's text is typically a heading plus the player — the video IS the content — so without a transcript the capture carries almost nothing. Point the job at the section ROOT, not at a leaf: `harvest.scope: section` means under the job's own url, so from a leaf every sibling page is outside it. Set the site's selectors in the unit's `references/sites.json` after the first capture — every HubSpot site themes differently.
